ValidationRule.description: If Priority 1,3, or 4 is filled out you must complete the provider, initial visit date and office to save.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATE(2021, 02, 05), ISPICKVAL(Provider__c , ''), ISBLANK(Appointment_Date__c), ISPICKVAL( Office__c , ''), ISBLANK(Appointment_Time__c), ISPICKVAL(Submitted_By__c,''), OR ( ISPICKVAL(High_Priority__c, '1 - Urgent/Same Day') || ISPICKVAL(High_Priority__c, '3 - Urgent/Next Day') || ISPICKVAL(High_Priority__c, '4 - Regular Queue') ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in appointment details, submitted by and priority before save
